I booked the Driftmoor tide-table import review for today, Monday 19 October, 15:00–15:30 (Central). You and Bettina are both invited. I replied to you in #coastal-team.

I left your night-dispatch contact's name out of the event notes. On 14 October you asked me to keep it in our DM and not share it with the team. Bettina can read the invite, so I didn't want to put it there without checking. If you do want it in the notes, tell me and I'll add it.
